subject: Biology
title: Biotechnology and its Applications
summary: Biotechnology is applied in agriculture (GM crops — Bt cotton, pest-resistant tobacco via RNAi), medicine (human insulin, gene therapy, molecular diagnosis), transgenic animals, and in industry.
Bt toxin from Bacillus thuringiensis kills specific insects; cry genes are put into crops. RNA interference silences parasite genes in plants.
Recombinant human insulin (Eli Lilly, 1983) is made by producing chains A and B separately in E. coli and joining them. The first gene therapy (1990) treated ADA deficiency.
Ethical issues — GEAC oversight, biopiracy and patents (basmati rice, turmeric, neem) — are also part of the chapter.

formulas.name: Bt toxin
formulas.formula: Bacillus thuringiensis makes inactive protoxin crystals → alkaline pH of insect gut activates them → toxin binds midgut epithelial cells, creates pores → swelling, lysis, death
formulas.note: The toxin doesn't harm the bacterium itself because it is stored as an inactive protoxin.

formulas.name: cry genes
formulas.formula: cryIAc and cryIIAb → cotton bollworms;  cryIAb → corn borer

formulas.name: RNA interference (RNAi)
formulas.formula: nematode Meloidogyne incognita infects tobacco roots;  nematode-specific genes introduced via Agrobacterium make sense + antisense RNA → dsRNA → silences parasite mRNA → parasite dies

formulas.name: GM crop benefits
formulas.formula: tolerance to abiotic stress (cold, drought, salt, heat);  less reliance on chemical pesticides;  reduced post-harvest losses;  better mineral use;  enhanced nutrition (Golden rice — vitamin A)

formulas.name: Human insulin
formulas.formula: insulin = chains A and B joined by disulphide bonds;  pro-insulin has an extra C-peptide removed during maturation;  Eli Lilly (1983) made A and B chains separately in E. coli and joined them

formulas.name: Gene therapy for ADA deficiency
formulas.formula: 1990, a 4-year-old girl;  lymphocytes grown in culture, functional ADA cDNA introduced using a retroviral vector, cells returned;  periodic infusions needed;  a permanent cure would need the gene in early embryonic cells
formulas.note: ADA = adenosine deaminase; its deficiency affects the immune system.

formulas.name: Molecular diagnosis
formulas.formula: PCR (detects very low amounts of DNA — HIV in suspected AIDS patients, mutations in cancer);  ELISA (antigen–antibody interaction);  probes with radioactive labels and autoradiography

formulas.name: Transgenic animals uses
formulas.formula: study of normal physiology and development;  disease models (cancer, cystic fibrosis, rheumatoid arthritis, Alzheimer's);  biological products (α-1-antitrypsin for emphysema);  vaccine safety testing (polio on transgenic mice);  chemical safety (toxicity testing)

formulas.name: Rosie the cow
formulas.formula: first transgenic cow (1997) — milk with human α-lactalbumin (2.4 g/L), nutritionally more balanced for human babies

formulas.name: Ethics and patents
formulas.formula: GEAC (Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee) checks GM research validity and safety of GM organisms for public use;  biopiracy: use of bio-resources without authorisation or payment;  basmati patented in the USA (1997) — India has 27 documented basmati varieties

examples.title: Why isn't Bt toxic to the bacterium?
examples.problem: Bacillus thuringiensis makes a lethal toxin. Why doesn't it die?
examples.solution: The toxin is stored as an inactive protoxin crystal; it becomes active only in the alkaline gut of insects.

examples.title: C-peptide
examples.problem: Why was pro-insulin a problem for recombinant production?
examples.solution: Insulin is made as pro-insulin with an extra C-peptide that must be removed; Eli Lilly avoided this by making A and B chains separately and joining them with disulphide bonds.

examples.title: Detecting HIV early
examples.problem: Which technique detects HIV before symptoms appear?
examples.solution: PCR — it amplifies very small amounts of viral nucleic acid. ELISA is also used to detect HIV antibodies.

examples.title: RNAi target
examples.problem: In pest-resistant tobacco, which organism's mRNA is silenced?
examples.solution: The mRNA of the nematode Meloidogyne incognita — the dsRNA made by the plant silences a specific nematode gene, so it cannot survive.

examples.title: Golden rice
examples.solution: Rice genetically modified to make β-carotene (provitamin A), to fight vitamin A deficiency.

topics.title: Three critical research areas
topics.explain: Providing the best catalyst (improved organism, usually a microbe or pure enzyme); creating optimal conditions through engineering for the catalyst to act; and downstream processing to purify the product.

topics.title: Green revolution and GM crops
topics.explain: The green revolution tripled food supply with improved varieties, better management and agrochemicals, but agrochemicals were costly and harmful. GM crops offer an alternative path to increase yields with fewer chemicals.

topics.title: Genetically engineered insulin
topics.explain: Before recombinant insulin, insulin from slaughtered cattle and pigs caused allergies in some patients. Recombinant insulin is made in bacteria and is identical to human insulin.

topics.title: Recombinant therapeutics
topics.explain: About 30 recombinant therapeutics are approved worldwide (12 marketed in India). They are safer and more effective because they don't induce unwanted immunological responses.

topics.title: Transgenic animals
topics.explain: Animals whose DNA has been manipulated to carry and express an extra (foreign) gene. Over 95% of existing transgenic animals are mice; others include rats, rabbits, pigs, sheep, cows and fish.

topics.title: Biopiracy and India
topics.explain: Industrialised nations are rich in finance but poor in biodiversity; developing nations are the opposite. The Indian Parliament amended the Indian Patents Bill to address patent terms, emergency provisions and research and development initiatives.

ratta: cryIAc, cryIIAb → cotton bollworm;  cryIAb → corn borer.

Gene therapy 1990: ADA deficiency, retroviral vector.
